title: Lunar Bindery & Spells
description: A witch in a long dark blue robe and wide-brimmed hat stands at the wooden door of a mystical shop named Lunar Bindery & Spells, holding a glowing lantern. The storefront is filled with hanging scrolls, dried herbs, open chests of potion bottles, and a crystal ball on a table under a full moon at night.
prompt: A nighttime fantasy street scene featuring an ornate dark blue storefront called Lunar Bindery & Spells. A witch wearing a long blue robe and wide-brimmed hat stands at the wooden door holding a glowing lantern. The shop exterior is covered with hanging scrolls, dried herbs, wooden crates filled with potion vials, and a large crystal ball resting on a blue-clothed table. Full moon illuminates the alley with hanging papers and mystical signs, detailed digital painting, atmospheric lighting.
